title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to Amazon Connect Push Notification
description: Create an API Gateway REST API that sends in-app push notifications to Amazon Connect users via direct AWS service integration

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a direct AWS service integration to Amazon Connect.
A POST request is transformed via VTL mapping templates and forwarded directly to the Connect CreateNotification API.
Using this Customers can send In-app notifications such as System notifications or custom organizational messages to Connnect Agents and Admins.
Notifications appear in the Amazon Connect workspace header for targeted users.
Supports localized content (11 locales), priority levels, TTL expiration, and tag-based access control.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
